description: Confirmed root cause: History.Delivery omitted thread_id and TranscriptHistory placed every confirmed response with input. Added thread_id to Engine confirmation request, persisted receipt and optional fingerprint field; target resolution now ensures/reuses child transcript under verified input placement root using existing scope and permissions. Two regressions failed first (new-thread placement, existing-thread receipt), then passed. mix q passed; 105 targeted checks passed across delivery, ingress, transcript, worker and history LiveView suites. Existing stored entries are not automatically backfilled; restart ZAQ and send a fresh request to verify new history placement.
title: Preserve delivery thread placement in canonical history
